RUNTIME SHA

investigate and fix the actual Render/startup cause before continuing.

==================================================

B. English:
"What is your name?"

C. Technical:
"Why can a React Native chat become slow?"

D. Longer business-analysis question

For every test require:

- no circular spinner
- no ActivityIndicator
- no watchdog banner
- no Still Working banner
- no post-answer thinking
- no large routine loader
- one minimal pre-token indicator only
- first REAL streamed text becomes visible while generation continues
- final response completes cleanly
- UI returns immediately to IDLE

Record actual owner-device evidence.

If no physical device can be accessed by Rork:
do NOT fake PASS.
Return OWNER DEVICE QA REQUIRED.

==================================================

T2 backend receive
T3 provider request

T5 client first delta
T6 first visible text
T7 completion
T8 UI idle

Return:

TIME TO FIRST VISIBLE TOKEN
TOTAL RESPONSE TIME
POST-COMPLETION CLEANUP TIME

The first visible token must be actual response content,
not typing text.

==================================================
4. FINAL AUTONOMOUS OWNER-CHAT TEST
==================================================

This is the decisive test.

Use the REAL production IVX IA Chat.

Create ONE harmless, uniquely identifiable engineering change.

The owner approves ONCE.

OWNER CHAT REQUEST
→ REAL APPROVAL RECORD
→ REAL TASK ID

→ REAL QUEUE ENTRY
→ REAL WORKER CLAIM

→ REAL FILE CHANGE
→ REAL DIFF
→ REAL TEST
→ REAL COMMIT
→ REAL OWNER-GITHUB PUSH
→ REAL DEPLOY
→ REAL RUNTIME SHA
→ REAL PRODUCTION ACCEPTANCE

RORK MUST NOT MANUALLY IMPLEMENT THE TEST CHANGE.

If Rork writes the code itself:
AUTONOMOUS END-TO-END TEST = FAIL.

==================================================
5. APPROVAL PERSISTENCE
==================================================

The owner approval must persist against the SAME task.

Verify:

- no second authorization prompt for retry
- no duplicate task
- no duplicate owner approval
- same task resumes after recoverable failure
- same Task ID retained

Only ask again if scope materially changes.

==================================================
6. REAL FAILURE RECOVERY
==================================================

GitHub rate limit
temporary 403
network timeout
provider timeout
worker restart
deploy transient failure

Verify:

detect
→ bounded retry
→ resume
→ continue

without owner re-approval.

If retries exhaust:
return BLOCKED with exact stage/error.

No generic:
"Autonomous coder blocked"

without underlying evidence.

QA

Do NOT show invented percentages.

TIMESTAMP

give a concise senior technical answer.

Do not start an autonomous task.

For a REAL code task:

Then show actual backend evidence.

Do not generate long generic business narrative unless requested.
